units.text: If your Total and Permanent Disability (TPD) discharge request is denied, Nelnet will notify you of the reason for the denial.
supporting_chunk_ids: Total and Permanent Disability Discharge | Federal Student Aid#1_0::c0008
units.reason: The context states Nelnet will notify you of the reason for the denial.

units.text: You may ask for a reevaluation within 12 months of the denial notice if you provide new information supporting your eligibility.
supporting_chunk_ids: Total and Permanent Disability Discharge | Federal Student Aid#1_0::c0008
units.reason: The context explains that you may ask for reevaluation if you provide new information within 12 months of the denial notice.

units.text: If you don't request reevaluation within that 12-month period and still want reevaluation, you must submit a new TPD discharge application with new information about your disabling condition that wasn't provided before.
supporting_chunk_ids: Total and Permanent Disability Discharge | Federal Student Aid#1_0::c0008
units.reason: The context states that if you don't request reevaluation within 12 months, you must submit a new application with new information not provided before.

units.text: You become responsible again for repaying your loans, and your loan holder will notify you when your first payment is due.
supporting_chunk_ids: Total and Permanent Disability Discharge | Federal Student Aid#1_0::c0008
units.reason: The context states you are again responsible for repaying loans and loan holder will notify when first payment is due.

units.text: If you applied for a TEACH Grant service obligation discharge, you're again responsible for meeting its terms and conditions.
supporting_chunk_ids: Total and Permanent Disability Discharge | Federal Student Aid#1_0::c0008
units.reason: The context states that if you applied for discharge of a TEACH Grant service obligation, you are again responsible for meeting its terms and conditions.
